fields.validationRule: Must match regex ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$ and be an official exchange trading day

fields.pitRequirement: Cannot be used for decision prior to session close for EOD strategies; used as fill price for next-session execution at 09:15:00+05:30 of next tradable day
fields.validationRule: open > 0 and open >= lower_circuit and open <= upper_circuit

fields.pitRequirement: Cannot be observed prior to session close
fields.validationRule: high >= open and high >= close and high >= low

fields.pitRequirement: Cannot be observed prior to session close
fields.validationRule: low <= open and low <= close and low <= high and low > 0

fields.pitRequirement: Available strictly at 15:35:00+05:30 for EOD strategy signal generation
Delivery-dependent strategy filters cannot execute until 18:00:00+05:30; cannot execute on next-day open unless published before 09:00:00

fields.economicTimestamp: Gross daily traded value in INR
fields.validationRule: turnover >= 0 and isFinite(turnover) and turnover >= (low * volume * 0.5)

fields.pitRequirement: Must be true for next-bar execution; non-trading sessions or suspended scrips must be skipped
fields.validationRule: boolean (volume > 0 and close > 0 and not isSuspended and not isHoliday)

fields.publicationTimestamp: Annual declaration with ad-hoc circular revisions
fields.availableAt: Effective immediately upon official exchange circular timestamp
fields.pitRequirement: Future trading holidays cannot be assumed until formally published
fields.validationRule: Complete coverage of all calendar days in evaluation window

fields.publicationTimestamp: Exchange announcement date (typically 4 weeks prior to effective date)
fields.pitRequirement: Survivorship bias elimination: historical universe membership strictly point-in-time as of trade_date
fields.validationRule: Historical membership table contains as_of_date with active constituent flags

fields.economicTimestamp: Ex-date of split, bonus, rights, dividend
fields.availableAt: Ex-date 09:15:00+05:30 for price adjustment; announcement date for forward knowledge
fields.pitRequirement: Adjusted historical prices cannot reflect split/bonus before the official ex-date
fields.validationRule: Adjustment factors strictly applied on or after ex_date only

fields.publicationTimestamp: Actual exchange filing timestamp (typically 15-21 days after quarter end)
fields.pitRequirement: Filing data strictly unavailable to research harness prior to filing_timestamp
Earnings data cannot be used until board meeting outcome is officially stamped
